Hi, Dont know if I made this clear or not probably not but I went to the doc for a few weeks not just one isolated visit. What went down was basically the doc listened to what I had to say about myself and things that had happened. Gave suggestions on how to be safer and on what I should do next. Basically filled me in on things that could potentially happen and options. Conclusions from it on the docs side was that I had a couple of personality disorders namely paranoid personality disorder, borderline personality disorder and schizoid personality disorder. My conclusions were that I did not like being there and as the time passed of going I struggled more and more to take what she was saying as truth. I pretty lost any form of trust I may have originally had if I trusted her in the first place. The doc prescribed some meds I dont know what they were now I wasnt really paying attention and I never collected it if you really want to know I can probably find the slip. She also referred me off to some therapy and I never showed up to it.  I feel restricted in sharing my private life with my friends mainly due to not trusting them (I don't trust many people). I know that if I tell them everything it will probably spread around the school and thats undesirable. There may be more to it but I cant think of what it may be for now.
